subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main now covers channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep this as canonical channel view
options.body: Use this issue to define channel-separated tabs and merged timeline semantics, while linking broader workspace work as a sibling design input.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Move the remaining behavior into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 and close this only after that issue explicitly owns the channel toggle semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical channel view
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define channel-separated tabs and merged timeline semantics, while linking broader workspace work as a sibling design input.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current partial session grouping implementation and is the closest visible owner for deciding whether that grouping is enough or should become a timeline toggle.
